name: note1_loop
note: Research note memo, 19-frame completed sequence, pose-to-pose with holds (74 ticks @10FPS = 7.4s, widget rate 1.0, play 1 cycle). From idle she pulls a clipboard from behind her back, takes out a pencil, scribbles a note (5-6 x3), pauses, taps the pencil on her chin thinking (8-9 x2), gets an idea, scribbles fast (11-12 x4), proudly shows the viewer the lemon doodle she drew (13-14 x2), puts the clipboard away behind her back and returns to idle. PROP RULES: the clipboard (small, brown, ONE silver clip on top, one white sheet) is ALWAYS held by the hand on the RIGHT side of the image; the yellow pencil with a pink eraser is ALWAYS in the hand on the LEFT side of the image. The 'idea' beat is carried by her face and the raised pencil only — no floating symbols (they are removed by the matte cleanup). GENERATOR: flux2-klein-4b on the LAN imagegen server, not gen_frames.py — see the 'klein' key and prompts/animation_prompts.md for the per-frame recipe. The frame texts are kept in gen_frames.py format so the clip can also be regenerated with Gemini. Frame 18 is a file copy of frame 0. The pencil is described as 'small short thin' in every frame where it is held away from the clipboard (3, 8, 9, 10); without it klein draws it up to 1.5x longer or much thicker than in the writing frames. Keyed with: slice_and_key.py --no-align --no-scale-norm --match sprites/idle1_loop/idle1_loop_00.png

modes.chain: references = [design ref, frame N]. gen_frames.py CHAIN_NOTE wrapper. Only works when the requested pose is FAR from frame N; a small change is ignored and frame N is copied.
modes.pose: references = [design ref, frame N] where frame N has a very DIFFERENT arm layout. Wrapper says 'reuse its character, outfit and clipboard design, but her arms are in a completely NEW position'. Frames sharing the same N and seed keep the same body/clipboard layout, so editing a few words of the pose text gives a controlled variation (this is how in-betweens are made).
modes.face: references = [design ref, frame N], same seed as frame N. Wrapper says 'keep the body EXACTLY the same, what CHANGES is her FACE / the page'. The body is copied pixel-stable; only the face, the page content and small marks change.

klein.retouch: Frames 13-14: a tiny stray loop on the hair outline (left of her head) was removed by copying the box x326-372, y300-350 of the 1024px raw from frame 5, whose outline there is identical within 1px (same reference frame and seed).
